name: Wireless Device Manager
notes: Free Lite edition. One selected device with sole-visible auto-selection. Battery/charging/control are capability-gated and battery percentages remain device-reported. Canonical top-right and bottom Pro upgrade surfaces are active and use the PackRat maker Marketplace page until the verified direct Pro listing exists.
blocker: Bluetooth hardware QA is waived for this release. Lite is code-complete. Its canonical top-right and bottom Pro upgrade surfaces are active now and default to the PackRat maker page. Final public Lite release still follows Pro-first publication: once the verified direct Pro Marketplace URL exists, record it, rebuild Lite so both CTAs route directly to Pro, and run the final Lite shipping gate.
release_gate: locked dependency install and npm audit with 0 vulnerabilities
ten generated profiles across Lite/Pro: Standard, Mini, XL, Plus and Neo
x64 and ARM64 self-contained native Windows Bluetooth bridge publish
one-shot bridge snapshot and persistent stdio protocol smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
PackRat Lite Pro Portfolio Audit and Rat Ship Marketplace Routing CI
Bluetooth audio-control physical matrix explicitly waived by product owner for initial release

automated_release_evidence.lite_pro_upgrade_fallback: PASS - Lite top-right Upgrade to Pro and bottom Pro feature card are always visible after Lite edition state is known; direct Pro /product/ URL is used when verified, otherwise both route to https://marketplace.elgato.com/maker/packrat.

profiles.note: Lite bundles MY DEVICE, BATTERY and CONTROL around one shared selected wireless device, with sole-visible auto-selection. Plus/Neo remain key-only with no fake Encoder action.

upsell.behavior: Top-right Upgrade to Pro and bottom Pro feature card are always visible in Lite. Both use the verified direct Pro /product/ URL when available; otherwise both open the PackRat maker page.

final_boundary: Bluetooth physical QA is waived. Lite can use the PackRat maker fallback before Pro publication. Publish Wireless Device Manager Pro first; once its exact public Marketplace URL is recorded in products/lite-pro-map.json, rebuild/revalidate Lite so both upgrade CTAs route directly to Pro, then complete the final Lite shipping gate.
